text.p: Banamex, the banking unit of Grupo Financiero Banamex Accival, said on Thursday it privately placed $215 million in certificates backed by credit card receivables.

Banamex, which has completed five such deals, said the backing for the deal would be securitized expected future proceeds from the bank's handling of foreign Visa cards and Mastercards used in Mexico.

Each certificate, Series 1997-A, represents an indivisible interest in the assets of the Credi Card Merchant Vouchers Receivables Master Trust, Banamex said. The deal will permit the re-sale of the paper under rule 144-A.
Interest and principal payments are guaranteed by Capital Markets Assurance Corp.
Banamex said it received a Aaa rating by Moddy's Investors Services Inc and a Triple-A rating by Standard and Poor's Corp. It said the deal would improve foreign currency funding costs.
